text: 79वें मिनट में Westport Albion ने अपनी बढ़त को बचाने के लिए खेल की चाल धीमी कर दी और बचाव को मजबूत किया। उन्होंने प्रेसिंग कम की, जिसका मतलब है कि वे विरोधी टीम पर कम दबाव डाल रहे थे, और गेंद पर नियंत्रण भी थोड़ा कम हो गया। इससे Kingsmoor FC के मौके बढ़ गए, क्योंकि उनका xG लगभग 0.92 तक पहुंच गया है, जिसका मतलब है कि उन्हें गोल के अच्छे मौके मिले। Westport Albion ने अपनी ताकत बचाकर अपना 3-2 का बढ़त बनाए रखने की कोशिश की[#1459].

- This tactical shift resulted in a decreased press aggressiveness (PPDA rising from 4.4 to 7.6), leading to fewer high turnovers (from 5 to 0) and a slower build-up, consistent with a more cautious, defensive posture to protect the narrow advantage [#1459].
- Kingsmoor FC, playing a 4-4-2 with wide crossing play, aimed to exploit width and deliver crosses, but after Westport's drop in line height and tempo, they struggled to create high-quality chances, as indicated by a low expected goals (xG) and no shots in the last 10 minutes.
- Westport Albion's original style of direct, vertical passing was moderated after the change to prevent risky turnovers, sacrificing some offensive potential (xG dropping from 0.26 to 0.19) in favor of solidity and controlling possession deeper in their own half [#1459].

- Westport Albion reduced press from 0.45 to 0.25 and tempo from 0.5 to 0.35 to protect their lead at 79' [#1459]  
- After the tactical change, Westport Albion's xG dropped from 0.26 to 0.19 and shots decreased from 4 to 1 [#1459]  
- Westport Albion's possession percentage fell from 48.8% to 44.9% following the tactical adjustment [#1459]  
- Opponent xG increased from 0 to 0.92 after the change, indicating more risk from Kingsmoor FC [#1459]  
- Westport Albion's PPDA increased from 4.4 to 7.6 and high turnovers reduced from 5 to 0, showing less pressing intensity and risk [#1459]
